name: create_floors_slabs
author: hprebar
title: Convert Boundary Surfaces into Native Revit Floors
description: Converts planar boundary curve loops from Grasshopper into native Revit Floor slab elements on specified target Levels.
notes: Builds CurveLoop polygons in feet and invokes Floor.Create.

boundaryLoops.description: Array of closed boundary polygon loops in meters.

structural.description: Whether to mark the created floor as a structural element.
